prompt: How many more letters does the name of the city that the director of "Whiplash" (2014) was born in have compared the name of the city in which the film first premiered?
answer:
“Whiplash” director Damien Chazelle was born in **Providence**, which has 10 letters. The film first premiered in **Park City**, which has 8 letters (excluding the space).

**Answer: 2 more letters.**
